chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washa' from Ahmad ibn A'idh from Abu Khadeeja from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
Al-Ajwa is the mother of dates, and it is that which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent down from Paradise to Adam (peace be upon him).
Whatever palm-trees you cut down or leave standing upon their roots

key_terms.أُصُولِهَا: Its roots, referring to the base of the tree
key_terms.أُمُّ التَّمْرِ: Mother of dates, indicating the primary or best variety
key_terms.الْعَجْوَةُ: Al-Ajwa, a specific high-quality variety of dates
key_terms.لِينَةٍ: Palm-tree, specifically referring to date palms in this context

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Ajwa dates in Shia tradition and how do they relate to the Quran?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elevates the Ajwa date to a primordial status, identifying it as the specific fruit sent down to Adam from Paradise, thereby linking human sustenance directly to divine grace. It offers a specific exegetical interpretation of Surah Al-Hashr (59:5), where the general term 'palm-trees' (līnāt) is narrowed to refer specifically to Ajwa, highlighting its unique spiritual and physical significance in Shia tradition. This classification underscores the Ajwa's role not merely as food, but as a symbol of purity and connection to the Garden, often cited in discussions of prophetic medicine and cosmic origins.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Ahmad Bin A’iz, from Abu Khadeeja, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Al-Ajwa is the mother of the dates and it is which Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Sent down from the Paradise to Adamas, and these are the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic
[59:5] Whatever palm-tree you cut down or leave standing upon its roots
en.sarwar: 11. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Ahmad ibn ‘A’idh from abu Khadijah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
al-‘Ajwah is the mother of dates. It is the date that Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, sent from paradise for Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, as mentioned in His words, ‘
. . . whatever you cut down of palm trees and left standing on their trunks’
